req.title: Health responds under load-balancer probe path
req.statement: The system shall serve GET /health/ with sub-second latency and no external dependencies required.
triggers: health responds under load-balancer probe path

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the /health/ endpoint should respond with sub-second latency and no external dependencies, returning an HTTP 2xx status code. The test suite will verify this behavior under normal conditions, handle client errors, and test boundary conditions for latency.

tests.name: test_health_endpoint_positive
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running and accessible.
actions: Send a GET request to the /health/ endpoint.
expected: The response time is less than 1 second.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
import time

client = TestClient(app)
start_time = time.time()
response = client.get('/health/')
end_time = time.time()

assert response.status_code == 200
assert (end_time - start_time) < 1

tests.name: test_health_endpoint_negative
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running and accessible.
actions: Send a POST request to the /health/ endpoint.
expected: The response status code is 405 (Method Not Allowed).
tests.executable:
from main import app
